audience: sales and recruiting teams that find and check business email addresses with Findymail

useCases.title: Find a work email from a name
useCases.text: Check the finder credits first. Then give a full name and a company domain to find a work email, which spends credits when found.

useCases.title: Verify addresses before an import
useCases.text: Check each email address for validity and deliverability. Every check spends one verifier credit, whatever the result.

useCases.title: Run a lead search in plain language
useCases.text: Describe the companies and people you want. Then poll the search status and read the results page by page.

useCases.title: Track credit use for the month
useCases.text: Read the remaining finder or verifier credits. Then read the daily or monthly usage over a date range.

useCases.title: Review intent signals from your monitors
useCases.text: List the keyword, new-hire and job-change monitors with their match counts. Read the signals they found, with the contact and company.
